description: What a conditional's result column DECLARES once its branches are folded. COALESCE, IFF, NVL, IFNULL, GREATEST, LEAST and CASE all fold the same way, and the pairs that decide the answer were measured cell by cell on the account: an approximate number swallows an exact one, DATE < TIMESTAMP_NTZ < TIMESTAMP_LTZ < TIMESTAMP_TZ, a NULL branch carries no type and decides nothing EXCEPT beside a STRING where it takes the unbounded width, nothing but NULL branches reads VARCHAR(16777216) too, a boolean outranks a number in either order, a string beside one other family joins that family, and ZEROIFNULL folds with a zero TWO integer digits wide where an explicit COALESCE(x, 0) uses the ordinary one-digit zero. The FLOAT family is compared by NAME alone: no precision or scale is reported for it. Converted 1:1 from query/ConditionalBranchTypeTest (now retired). The Java read the declared type off the ResultSet's own column metadata, which the testkit cannot reach; the converted tests wrap each expression in a VIEW and read INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS, which carries the EXPRESSION's declared type but stops a string at the 16777216 a column can declare, as CTAS and DESCRIBE do, so the 128MB width reads 16777216 there (live-measured). The renderer maps INFORMATION_SCHEMA's own spellings back to the declared ones: TEXT is VARCHAR with CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, and a BINARY branch is rendered by its type name alone, since live reports NULL for both lengths of a BINARY column.

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE cbt (i INT, n NUMBER(10,2), m NUMBER(5,4), f FLOAT, v VARCHAR(5), w VARCHAR(9), d DATE, ts TIMESTAMP_NTZ, tl TIMESTAMP_LTZ, bo BOOLEAN, tz TIMESTAMP_TZ, tm TIME, bn BINARY(5), p1 NUMBER(1,0), p21 NUMBER(2,1), p99 NUMBER(9,9), p40 NUMBER(4,0), vt VARCHAR(30), vn VARCHAR(9))

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cbt_v AS SELECT COALESCE(n, f) AS a1, COALESCE(f, i) AS a2, COALESCE(i, f) AS a3, COALESCE(m, f) AS a4, COALESCE(f, 1) AS a5, NVL(f, n) AS a6, GREATEST(n, f) AS a7, LEAST(n, f) AS a8 FROM cbt

SELECT LISTAGG(CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('TEXT','VARCHAR') THEN 'VARCHAR(' || CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH || ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' THEN 'NUMBER(' || NUMERIC_PRECISION || ',' || NUMERIC_SCALE || ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'BINARY' THEN 'BINARY(' || CHARACTER_OCTET_LENGTH || ')' ELSE DATA_TYPE END, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CBT_V'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE cbt (i INT, n NUMBER(10,2), m NUMBER(5,4), f FLOAT, v VARCHAR(5), w VARCHAR(9), d DATE, ts TIMESTAMP_NTZ, tl TIMESTAMP_LTZ, bo BOOLEAN, tz TIMESTAMP_TZ, tm TIME, bn BINARY(5), p1 NUMBER(1,0), p21 NUMBER(2,1), p99 NUMBER(9,9), p40 NUMBER(4,0), vt VARCHAR(30), vn VARCHAR(9))
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cbt_v AS SELECT COALESCE(m, i) AS a1, COALESCE(p99, p40) AS a2, COALESCE(i, 1.5) AS a3, IFF(bo, 1, 2.5) AS a4 FROM cbt

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cbt_v AS SELECT COALESCE(d, ts) AS a1, COALESCE(ts, d) AS a2, IFF(bo, ts, d) AS a3, NVL(d, ts) AS a4, CASE WHEN bo THEN d ELSE ts END AS a5, COALESCE(ts, tl) AS a6, COALESCE(d, tl) AS a7, COALESCE(ts, tz) AS a8, COALESCE(tl, tz) AS a9, COALESCE(d, tz) AS a10, COALESCE(tm, tm) AS a11 FROM cbt
